deadline.value: Complete your file by January 15 to be considered for department financial aid; later applications are still considered for admission.
deadline.quote: The application should be completed, including all supporting documents, by January 15 if you wish to be considered for available math department financial aid | Applications completed after January 15 will still be considered for admission, and even for financial support, if it is still available

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required for admission.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required for admission

gre_subject.value: GRE scores are not required for admission.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores are not required for admission

supervisor.value: You do not need to secure an advisor before applying or being admitted.
supervisor.quote: It is not necessary to secure an advisor prior to submission or admission

funding.value: Assistantships and fellowships are decided by the department and are competitive.
funding.quote: Decisions on applications and financial support are competitive, and quantifiable data are only a part of the evaluation process

entry_route.value: A master's degree is not needed to apply to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Note that an MS is not required for application to the PhD program in Mathematics

toefl_min.quote: On the TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language), the following minimum scores are required for admission: 550 (paper-based exam) 213 (computer-based exam) 79 (internet-based exam)

ielts_min.quote: On the IELTS (International English Language Testing Service), the following minimum score is required for admission: 6.5

app_fee.value: The application fee is $70 for international applicants, and the Math Department cannot waive it.
app_fee.quote: The application fee is $70 for international applicants and $50 for U.S. citizens and permanent residents | it cannot be waived by the Math Department

notes: The department's applprocd page gives a January 15 priority deadline for fall admission and financial aid. Funding is decided by the department from first-round offers in February. The Graduate School's May 15 deadline is also stated on the FAQ.
